name: Dallas
gaps: Parcels are ParcelsJoin (Dallas ParcelViewer — CaptureCAMA AGOL hosted) (https://services8.arcgis.com/9e1lVZPGgkrztAhh/ArcGIS/rest/services/Dallas_ParcelViewer_Service/FeatureServer/2). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card pattern and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. ALDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
~50% of parcels have TOTAL_AC=0 — fall back to DEEDACRES or computed area
Flagship alabamagis.com/dallas is still HTML-only; this AGOL layer is the REST source
